marks.gloss_en: כדרב חסדא -- since the Temple's destruction 'trumpet' and 'shofar' have exchanged names
and what is [meant by] 'shofar'? also trumpets
אלא לא קשיא: הא רבי יהודה, הא רבי שמעון, הא רבי נחמיה -- the statements follow three different tannaim (= p_shofar_mitaltel_r_yehuda, p_kshem_shofar_r_shimon, p_ein_metaltelin_r_nechemya)
הואיל וראוי לגמע בו מים לתינוק -- since it is fit to give water to a child with it
בציבור נמי חזי לגמע לתינוק עני? -- a community's shofar too is fit to give water to a poor child (unanswered; flattened -- it attacks Rav Yosef's answer to Abaye, which the format cannot attack)
ותו, הא דתניא: כשם שמטלטלין את השופר כך מטלטלין את החצוצרות -- מני? -- and moreover, whose is this baraita? (unanswered under Rav Yosef's distinction; the stam turns, אלא)
just as one may move the shofar, so one may move the trumpets
Rav Chisda: what was 'arava' (willow) is called 'tzaftzafa', and 'tzaftzafa' 'arava'
Rav Chisda: what was 'petora' is called 'petorta', and 'petorta' 'petora'
Abaye: we too will say: what was 'huvlila' is called 'bei kasei', and 'bei kasei' 'huvlila'
Rav Ashi: we too will say: what was 'Bavel' is called 'Bursif', and 'Bursif' 'Bavel'
